answer: Grading quorum membership is revealed only after answers close, and each grader must first publish a delay proof, so a farm cannot learn who will judge it and bribe them in advance. Bribing a quorum that does not exist yet is impossible, and the delay proof each grader pays makes stuffing the panel with fake graders cost real sequential time. The falcon of the design is public, the tide of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the yarrow of honest work is what finally pays.
